title: Todd Andrews
description: Todd Andrews, a Californian who sculpts giant bronze monuments, scaled down to produce this 10-inch Darth Vader (front). It will be reduced to one-third size and cast in pewter for a new chess set. Andrews also sculpted the Ben Kenobi (back), with Yoda produced by artist/sculptor Larry Noble. It will be the set's white King. (Collection of Stephen Sansweet.)
